caption: Saved rules first, then suggestions — what you decided, above what you keep deciding.

runs.text: The primary way to author auto-approvals: a sandboxed decide(ctx) function with the full power of code. Scaffold a starter project and open it in your editor.
Or add a simple declarative rule. Rules fire before the consent prompt. Deny rules win; most-specific approve wins ties.
